home.title: Gabriel Braga — Product & UX/UI Designer at Work & Co
home.description: Gabriel Braga (Hauser / Houser), Product, UX/UI & Interaction Designer at Work & Co in São Paulo. Case studies: PlayStation Connect, Decolar, Soundroom.

playstation.title: PlayStation Connect — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
playstation.description: PlayStation Connect design study by Gabriel Braga, Product & UX/UI Designer: a native PC launcher concept bringing PlayStation games, account continuity and subscription to PC gamers.

decolar.title: Decolar — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
decolar.description: Decolar design study by Gabriel Braga, Product & UX/UI Designer: a quiz-based flow that helps groups of friends align on a trip, with destination matches and a shared piggy bank.

soundroom.title: Soundroom — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
soundroom.description: Soundroom, a university UX/UI project by Gabriel Braga: a social platform to log listening sessions, write entries, create playlists and discover independent artists.
